summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an NI 43-101 Technical Report, a Preliminary Economic Assessment for the Franklin Project in Hopkins, Franklin and Titus Counties, Texas, with an effective date of July 20, 2026, plus eight Qualified Person consents (Exhibits 99.1–99.8). No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is disclosed; the filing is a routine technical disclosure incorporated by reference into the registrant's Form F-10EF shelf registration. Nothing here constitutes a special situation; no deal terms exist to watch.
